name: cprospect-industry
description: Ruling 66 of prds/prospect-marketing/rulings.md (10-20-26): a lead carries an industry, so a campaign list can select leads by industry (build plan § 7c.3). One enum on CProspect, stored as typed (custom entity, no prefix), whose options are kept identical to the Company's sector list (Account.cIndustrySector, read from crm-test 10-20-26). Optional; filled by imports, the Review queue and the lead's window; carried to the converted Company by null-fill. Handoff: cprospect-industry-crm-handoff.md.

fields.tooltipText: The business's industry, from the same list as a Company's Industry Sector. Optional. Filled by an import whose file has an industry column, by the reviewer in the Review queue, or here. Copied to the Company when the lead converts, if the Company has none.
